rationale: Price is sitting at 81% of today's range near the session high after a massive -13% gap down, with only 28 minutes to close and forced liquidation at market. The last five 1-minute candles show a clear short-term rollover from ~164.80 down to ~163.66, with the most recent candle showing elevated volume and a bearish close, but the 9-EMA at 164.22 is just above current price creating resistance uncertainty. With elevated VIXY (+3.84%), high relative volume (5.96x), and the risk of volatile end-of-day swings in either direction on a day with this magnitude of dislocation, the risk/reward does not justify a new position this close to the forced close.
